runtime_rule: All ordinary admission is derived from supplied bytes and disclosed resource policy; no corpus/path/name/hash/cache identity or benchmark-specific offset/length is reachable. Standard schema fields and input-size resource limits are allowed.

findings.issue: ELF signature is weaker than parser validation; cache branch has exact Mozilla hash and stored frame.
Size buckets are not corpus keys but are empirical portfolio thresholds.
24-48MiB and specialist exclusions are not model schema invariants.
WCSTools supports the seven-int, 28-byte stnum=0/motion subset; no magic/checksum at this entry point, so bounds/endian/full-inverse validation remain necessary.
Uncaught parser failure can prevent generic fallback.
DICOM scan is byte-derived; 240-byte raster layout is an unproven historical x-ray layout, but can remain a bounded paid reversible candidate while provenance/validation are strengthened.
ABI parsers need total bounded validation and nonfatal decline.
